extension.documentation:
Dedicated queue for BlobDiffWork. Without it the "blobDiff" category falls back to the "default" queue, which is shared with the rest of the platform: a burst of check-ins on large Office or PDF files would then starve every other asynchronous work of the instance.
A blob diff is deliberately CPU and I/O heavy (any2text conversion, Apache POI, PDFBox, then an O(n*m) alignment), so the concurrency is kept low on purpose. Raise maxThreads only after measuring, and remember that each thread can hold a whole extracted document in memory.
